frozen_commit_semantics: Commit containing this version of the immutable record and figure; original execution commits remain in the records. Predecessor links express history, not permission to consume invalid implementation outputs.

experiments.question: Can opposite temporal orders of two adjacent MaleCNS optic-column L1 inputs produce a direction-dependent T4 response?
experiments.result: L1 and subthreshold Mi1/Tm3 respond; no signal reaches T4, so direction selectivity cannot be evaluated.

experiments.question: Can a MaleCNS-derived T4 motion circuit distinguish the direction of a moving visual stimulus in the biologically expected way?
experiments.result: Opposite column orders differ in the frozen reduced T4 model; the main contrast depends on an imposed delayed inhibitory channel, not connectivity alone.

experiments.question: Does a bilateral right-minus-left visual-motion pathway difference produce opposite-signed steering commands for mirrored yaw-like optic-flow orders?
experiments.result: The independent bilateral DN difference is same-signed for both conditions; body simulation is withheld.

experiments.question: Are T4b and T4c absent from the EXP-003 downstream materialization because MaleCNS lacks their outputs, or because the target selection is incomplete?
experiments.result: Corrected filtering restores all four T4 subtype paths without reversing command or body sign.

experiments.question: Does the validated MaleCNS-derived visual-motion signal drive a different steering response when the same two-column motion order is reversed?
experiments.result: Order changes yaw magnitude, but both orders and zero command turn the same way; no biological steering validation.

experiments.question: Does the MaleCNS-constrained recurrent network enhance rotational/asymmetric selectivity at DNp15 relative to HS/H2 while suppressing symmetric translation-like responses?
experiments.result: The resolved circuit is stable and partially suppresses translation; recurrent enhancement is not reproduced, and calcium hierarchy targets remain unmatched.

experiments.question: Can a bilateral T4-derived H2/HS network enhance DNp15 yaw-like versus translation-like selectivity?
experiments.result: Incorrect electrical semantics and unstable recurrence make the provisional outputs uninterpretable.

experiments.question: Can explicit binocular visual motion propagate through a physiological T4/T5 approximation and identified MaleCNS visual projections into the frozen central optic-flow network and DNp15, with errors localized by stage?
experiments.result: An explicit provisional sensory chain propagates to both DNp15 cells; disconnection abolishes it, but published recurrent enhancement remains unmatched.

experiments.question: Can frozen sensory-derived DNp15 activity recruit identified neck motor cells and produce an interpretable open-loop physical motor tendency?
experiments.result: Identified neck motor contacts drive a causal, uncalibrated open-loop head-torque approximation, not walking steering.

verification.optional_environment: Historical FlyGym/MuJoCo; this command includes a body replay.

experiments.question: Can CvNA2-specific primary physiology identify a quantitative or posture-conditioned DNp15-to-head motor interface?
experiments.result: CvNA2 movement can be digitized; DN recruitment and posture-conditioned calibration remain unidentified.

experiments.question: Can measured bilateral compound-eye light from a controlled 3D world propagate through the frozen provisional visual-motion pathway to DNp15?
experiments.result: Measured bilateral facet light propagates through a provisional 65L/66R central-local readout to both DNp15 cells; no full-eye body registration.

experiments.question: Can the broader measured-grid local-direction representation satisfy numerical validation under its provisional type-level interface?
experiments.result: A 1500-neighborhood local-direction representation propagates, but translation refinement fails the 5% criterion (6.98%/9.27%).

experiments.question: Does temporal sensor refinement make the broader measured-grid representation numerically trustworthy under EXP-009's unchanged assumptions?
experiments.result: The fixed 1-to-0.5ms candidate improves translations to 4.95%/6.06% but still fails; discrepancies concentrate near possible blocker visibility.
